plainText:
Goh's Venomoth (Japanese: ゴウのモルフォン Go's Morphon) is the third that Goh in the Kanto region, and his fourth overall.

==History==
=== ===
 
In Working My Way Back to Mew!, Goh found at Vermilion Forest, and after a brief chase, threw a at it, successfully catching it. 

In Panic in the Park!, Venomoth joined a group made up of Goh's other Pokémon, which came into conflict with another faction led by Goh's Darmanitan, which was made up of and Pokémon, after the food around Cerise Park had been stolen. Venomoth and combined their attacks, which were blocked by 's . As the battle escalated, took control of the Bug-type group, but the infighting ended when lost control of itself, causing Cerise Park to become flooded. Venomoth joined the rest of the Pokémon in saving Goh's three , allowing them to evolve into and clear the storm with .

In There's a New Kid in Town!, Goh enlisted the help of Venomoth and Butterfree by having them use Stun Spore to locate the invisible crying , as its crying was affecting all the Pokémon in the proximity, and its paralysis caused Sobble to reappear, but it kept crying until hugged the Water Lizard Pokémon to comfort it, which caused Sobble to fall asleep and stop crying.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Venomoth attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and 's departure. After that, Venomoth posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others.

==Personality and characteristics==
Venomoth is shown as being useful for restraining its targets with its attack, seen when Venomoth helped locate the camouflaged when its crying was affecting everyone around it.

Venomoth is usually seen alongside , and they often combined their Stun Spore attacks together to cover a wider area whenever Goh deems it necessary. They also perform this combo on their own accord, seen when Venomoth and Butterfree used it during their confrontation with the - and faction in Panic in the Park!.

==Trivia==
Venomoth is Goh's first fully evolved Pokémon.
Venomoth is also the first dual-type Pokémon to be caught by Goh.
